name: DomA
notes: The README presents DomA as a browser agent from Stay Browser, and the LICENSE notice names Dom Actions; the commercial store build adds video download, a userscript manager and ad blocking on top of this core. The service worker implements browser_* tools (tabs, navigation, page content, element lists, click, text click, type, select, scroll, script execution, clipboard). browser_screenshot tags up to 150 visible interactive elements with data-som-idx and composites numbers and borders onto a clean viewport capture, grouping the overflow into areas A1 to A5; clicks fall back to CDP Input.dispatchMouseEvent through chrome.debugger. With the Jev switch on, a high-confidence Jev decision can execute a click or type without sending the image to the LLM. Models are user-supplied OpenAI-compatible endpoints. An MCP bridge (stdio server plus a local daemon on ports 3846/3847) and a CLI let Cursor, Claude or OpenClaw drive the extension. Not a fork, not archived. Code was read, not run.
summary: Source-available edition of the DomA browser-agent extension for Chrome and Edge: it observes pages through set-of-marks screenshots and element lists, acts with DOM events and CDP clicks, and serves its tools over MCP.
